body:
Opus2 rule (2026-11-21; Greg via Fable2: "NIE MA RECZNEGO HASHOWANIA"). The full rule is in memory greg-no-manual-hashing-2026-11-21. Fable2's recorded rulings are #7111 and #7112; #7112 is the stricter one and binds.
- AUTHOR runs (author-test refs: RED, GREEN, focused): keep exactly ONE check, HEAD == the named commit. Do NOT add tree, porcelain or review-freeze fingerprint checks. Cleanliness and identity come only from the launcher's sourceIdBefore and sourceIdAfter: equal, with "changes": [].
- Evidence transport: keep ONE whole-archive SHA-256 (transfer integrity, compared on receipt). No per-file SHA256SUMS.
- TLC: no script or Coord.tla sha checks (repository files are named by commit and source_id); keep the tla2tools.jar pinned-binary check. Other pinned external binaries (Engram) keep their SHA.
- Exception until the new test-ref wording lands: a LANDING FULL on a test/<item>-<fp8> ref keeps exactly what the CURRENT CLAUDE.md test-ref rule binds (fresh worktree equal to the commit, tree id, fingerprint, equal source ids). New wording: commit8 naming, source_id recorded before the push and compared by the runner's launcher.
- Add no new hashing, listing or identity step anywhere. Every review-pair brief carries: "Flag any new hashing, repository or index listing, or identity computation as a finding." Put that line, and any owner-required check, in the brief BEFORE the spawn. Follow-ups can only reach completed children.
- Before routing a pair, check that the owner has not already started one under an earlier GO (the 8d1d crossing on 2026-11-21).
The standing correction went to C6, C7, Windows B session-4 and session-5, the Mac Engram runner and s4 at 08:12Z.
